guide.blockbill.title: BlockBill — player guide
guide.blockbill.start.title: Free and paid services
guide.blockbill.start.body:
Free is always active: surface survival, wood and ordinary stone above Y40, basic crafting, food, combat and ordinary chests.

Your first 5 minutes of Survival include all 10 services. Afterwards, buy the services you need with in-game credits. No real money.

Press E → BlockBill. Overview shows your balance, service time and auto-renewal. Buy credits opens your inventory for selling.
guide.blockbill.services.title: Mining, sleep and sprint
guide.blockbill.services.body:
Individual services last 10 minutes of Survival.

Mine+ — 20 credits. Required to mine any ore, ancient debris or any block below Y40. Without access, these blocks cannot be broken.

Sleep+ — 15 credits. Required to sleep and skip the night. A normal bed still sets your respawn point; a straw bed does not and disappears after use.

Sprint+ — 15 credits. Required to sprint. Normal walking is always available. No new fatigue or slowness penalties are applied.
guide.blockbill.exchange.title: Selling and item prices
guide.blockbill.exchange.body:
BlockBill → Buy credits or Sell. Select an item from your inventory, then Sell 1 or Sell stack. Check the total and confirm with a second click.

All prices lists every item. Search uses item IDs, such as diamond or minecraft:stone. Wear lowers value; names and enchantments do not increase it. Prices use 0.01-credit precision.

Empty filled containers, bundles and charged items before selling them. If a stack changes, the sale is rejected; select it again. No items are dragged into this screen.
guide.blockbill.commands.title: Controls without commands
guide.blockbill.commands.body:
Every normal action is available from inventory → BlockBill.
Overview — services and auto-renewal.
Plans — bundles and plans.
Sell — credits and item prices.
Ad — temporary access.
Rules — this guide.

Commands remain an optional alternative:
/blockbill status
/blockbill services
/blockbill plans
/blockbill buy mine
/blockbill buy pro
/blockbill autorenew mine on
guide.blockbill.time.title: Active play time
guide.blockbill.time.body:
Periods run only while you are online in Survival. Offline, Creative, Spectator and Adventure time do not consume time or credits. Pausing single-player also stops the timers.

The BlockBill tab and its guide do not pause the game. Time keeps running while the inventory is open.

Trial: 5 minutes. Services and bundles: 10; Plus: 15; Pro: 30; Business: 60. Server lag may lengthen real time. Each service has its own expiry; buying early preserves remaining time.
guide.blockbill.safety.title: Your progress is saved
guide.blockbill.safety.body:
Your balance, fractional credits, paid periods, auto-renewal and ad timers survive death, reconnects and world restarts. Each player has a separate account.

Upgrading an old world preserves existing purchases and does not restart the trial. Back up your world before upgrading.

Restrictions apply only in Survival. Free lets you gather available resources and earn credits. Open paid menus stay open. Other potion effects are not removed; old version 0.3 penalties fade within their remaining short duration.

guide.blockbill.workshop.title: The workshop
guide.blockbill.workshop.body:
Enchant+ — 25 credits: open an enchanting table.
Anvil+ — 20: open any anvil.
Smith+ — 20: open a smithing table.

Each purchase adds 10 minutes. Workshop includes all three for 50 credits.

Crafting tables and furnaces stay free. Expiry does not close an already open menu. Purchase from Overview or Plans.
guide.blockbill.trade.title: Trading with villagers
guide.blockbill.trade.body:
Trade+ — 20 credits for 10 minutes.

Required to begin trading with an adult villager or wandering trader. Expiry does not close an already open trade menu.

Feeding or curing mobs, and selling items to BlockBill itself, do not require Trade+.
guide.blockbill.fishing.title: Fishing
guide.blockbill.fishing.body:
Fish+ — 15 credits for 10 minutes.

Required to cast a fishing rod. If access expires after casting, you may still reel in the existing line.

Included in Explorer: Mine+, Sprint+, Fish+, Storage+ for 50 credits.
guide.blockbill.storage.title: Item storage
guide.blockbill.storage.body:
Storage+ — 15 credits for 10 minutes.

Required to open an ender chest or shulker box. Ordinary chests and barrels are free.

Expiry does not close an open menu or confiscate items. Breaking and collecting containers follows normal Minecraft rules and Mine+ restrictions.
guide.blockbill.bundles.title: Four service bundles
guide.blockbill.bundles.body:
Basic — 40 credits: Mine+, Sleep+, Sprint+.

Workshop — 50: Enchant+, Anvil+, Smith+.

Explorer — 50: Mine+, Sprint+, Fish+, Storage+.

All Access — 120: all 10 services, including Travel+.

A bundle adds 10 minutes to each included service. If you cannot afford it, nothing is charged. Purchase from Plans.
guide.blockbill.autorenew.title: Optional auto-renewal
guide.blockbill.autorenew.body:
Disabled by default for each service. In Overview, use the Auto button beside the service you want.

When access expires, one 10-minute period is bought at the individual service price. Bundles and plans never auto-renew. Buying a plan leaves your switches unchanged.

If funds are insufficient or the period cannot be extended, auto-renewal is disabled until you turn it on again.

Simultaneous charges follow this order: mine, sleep, sprint, enchant, anvil, smith, trade, fish, storage, travel.
blockbill.rule.mine: Without access, ores, ancient debris and all blocks below Y40 cannot be mined.
blockbill.rule.sleep: Without access, sleeping and skipping the night are unavailable.
blockbill.rule.sprint: Required to sprint. Normal walking is always available.
blockbill.rule.enchant: Required to open an enchanting table.
blockbill.rule.smith: Required to open a smithing table.
blockbill.rule.trade: Required to start trading with an adult villager or wandering trader.
blockbill.rule.fish: Required to cast a fishing rod; an existing line can still be reeled in.
blockbill.rule.storage: Required to open ender chests and shulker boxes; ordinary chests and barrels are free.

blockbill.plans.note: Plans apply only to the buyer and add time to each service separately. Auto-renewal remains individual in 10-minute periods; buying a plan does not enable it or change its settings.

guide.blockbill.plans.title: Plus / Pro / Business
guide.blockbill.plans.body:
Plus — 90 credits: 15 minutes each for Mine+, Sleep+, Sprint+, Fish+, Storage+.

Pro — 300: 30 minutes for all 10 services.

Business — 540: 60 minutes for all 10 services.

Plans apply only to the purchaser. Time stacks per service. Plus after Pro adds time to five services without shortening the other periods.

Buying a plan does not change auto-renewal settings. Free remains active with every plan.

blockbill.rule.travel: Required to enter the Nether or End through portals. Returning to the Overworld is free.
guide.blockbill.travel.title: Travel between dimensions
guide.blockbill.travel.body:
Travel+ — 40 credits for 10 minutes.

Required to enter the Nether or End through a portal, including as a passenger. Returning to the Overworld is free.

Travel+ is included in All Access, Pro and Business. Other bundles do not include it.

Upgrades preserve old purchases but do not add Travel+ to them retroactively.
guide.blockbill.ads.title: Fictional advertising
guide.blockbill.ads.body:
Open Ad and select Watch. Wait for the 5-second server countdown, then select Claim 30 seconds.

The reward grants 30 seconds of active Survival access to all 10 services. No external sites, real payments or data collection.

The next reward is available 90 seconds of active Survival after the previous one. Rewards do not stack. Closing BlockBill cancels unfinished viewing. Ads do not purchase or extend paid subscriptions.
